speakcraft.reading_guide_text:
Romaji writes Japanese sounds with Latin letters. It is an approximate reading aid.

a/i/u/e/o are steady vowels; oo, ou and uu mark a long vowel: hold the sound.

sh as in ship; ch as in chip; ts as in cats. h is breathed, j as in jam, r is a light tap, like Spanish caro.

Example: 木のツルハシ = ki no tsuruhashi. Double consonants, as in ingotto, have a short pause.

Speak the Japanese name. This is not a translation or a pronunciation score.

Spanish guide: docs/JAPONES.md in the repository.
speakcraft.settings_note: Offline recognition. Text tolerance is not a phonetic score. Models: config/speakcraft/models/{es,de,ja}.
